note.question: How can convex optimization support bundle size pricing problem?
note.overview: This paper studies the bundle size pricing (BSP) problem in which a monopolist sells bundles of products to customers and the price of each bundle depends only on the size (number of items) of the bundle. Although this pricing mechanism is attractive in practice, finding optimal bundle prices is difficult because it involves characterizing distributions of the maximum partial sums of order statistics. In this paper, we propose to solve the BSP problem under a discrete choice model using only the first and second moments of customer valuations.
